question: Identify the correctly matched Gupta-period fiscal term with its associated meaning.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Vaishthika – forced or corvée labour**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• During the **Gupta period**, fiscal terms were used to denote various types of taxes, labour services, and levies.
 
• **Vaishthika** referred to **forced or corvée labour**, a system where people were required to work for the state or rulers without pay.
 
• Such labour was often utilized for **public works** like building roads, temples, or irrigation facilities.
 
• The concept of **forced labour** was common in many ancient societies as part of their administrative and economic systems.
 
• The term reflects the socio-economic structure during the **Gupta Empire**, which was known for its well-organized administration and taxation systems.
 
• The Gupta rulers implemented various forms of taxes and levies to maintain their empire and fund cultural and infrastructural projects.
 
• This fiscal term highlights the dependency on **human labour** for state-sponsored projects in an era with limited technological advancements.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Hiranya – tax paid in kind**__

 __
 
• **Hiranya** refers to taxes paid in the form of **gold, silver, or other valuables** instead of cash or crops.
 
• This type of tax was often levied on traders, merchants, and wealthy individuals.
 
• It symbolized the importance of **precious metals** in the economic transactions of the Gupta period.
 
 
 
• **Dhanya – levy on agricultural land**__
 __
 
• **Dhanya** refers to taxes or levies collected in the form of **grain or agricultural produce**.
 
• This was a common practice in agrarian economies like the Gupta Empire, where farmers contributed a share of their produce to the state.
 
• It indicates the reliance on **agriculture** as the primary economic activity during this period.
 
 
 
• **Bhoga – compulsory labour service**__
 
 
• **Bhoga** refers to **compulsory labour service** or dues paid in kind, typically involving the supply of goods or services to the state.
 
• This term demonstrates the system of **non-monetary taxation** prevalent during the Gupta period.
 
• It was often used to support the maintenance of state officials or military personnel.
